name: SIMASJS
description:
SIMASJS, the original you all know and love. The very first, but not least, implementation of SIMAS, written in JavaScript.
SIMASJS has some cool features none of the others have, such as instruction aliases (such as '+' for ADD), or the ability to spin up a web server on the fly.
Do keep in mind it is actively under development and can and will improve :)
creator: Turrnut
